test_title: PYST 13: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The match schedule was disturbed due to _______ rains.
solution:
The correct answer is Option (2) **"incessant".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **"incessant"** means continuous and without interruption.**(बिना किसी बाधा के/लगातार)**
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it explains why the match schedule was disturbed. - The word is an adjective and modifies the noun **"rains"**
